C1740.title: Lanzhou Hezi Huaxi Laboratory Nucleic Acid Test Result Entry Error Incident
C1740.summary: Lanzhou Hezi Huaxi Laboratory incorrectly entered nucleic acid test results, triggering public concern. The laboratory is part of Hezi Gene, which rapidly expanded across multiple regions in China, with numerous companies involved in testing and inspection businesses.
